messages.content: Describe precisely, from memory, the UI mechanics of the Resident Evil 4 Remake merchant shop screen AND the Resident Evil Village Duke shop screen. 1) How does the player set a QUANTITY when buying multiple of one item: exactly what appears, where on screen, how many inputs? 2) What visual and audio feedback fires on add, on buy, on sell? Give timings if known. 3) How is the merchant character framed relative to the item grid and the list? 4) RE Village Duke shopping list specifically: the paper/ledger visual treatment, typography, borders, and how the running total is presented. 5) What makes these shops feel SATISFYING rather than tedious when buying many items? Name the specific mechanics, not vibes. 6) What in these designs would NOT translate to a one-handed phone screen, and why. Terse, specific, no preamble.
